guide.title: How to create the image with AI
guide.intro: Give the AI (ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.) the two prompts in order, in the same conversation. The rules:

rules.aspect: A wide image, ideally 2:1 (2400 × 1200). ChatGPT produces at most 3:2 (1536 × 1024) — accepted, it just crops a little more.
rules.subjectRight: Subject only in the right third; keep the left calm, because the headline and search sit there.
rules.safeBands: Nothing important in the top and bottom 15% — they are cropped on wide screens.
rules.noText: No text, logos, signs or people.
rules.greek: A Greek landscape without any famous landmark (no Oia, windmills, Acropolis) and nothing that looks like Croatia, Italy or Spain.
rules.sameScene: Blue hour is the SAME image at dusk — an edit of the first one, not a new generation. Never black night.
rules.resolution: Upload the file exactly as the AI produced it; the tool checks it, cleans it and creates every size by itself.

guide.step2: Step 2 — Blue hour (same conversation, on the image from step 1)
guide.chatgptNote: The prompts are in English on purpose: image models follow them more faithfully. If the result shows a famous place or any text, ask 'remove it, keep everything else identical'.

prompts.home: Photorealistic wide landscape photograph for the hero banner of a Greek real-estate website. A contemporary Greek residence with clean white volumes, natural stone and large glass openings, set on a gentle hillside above a quiet coastal town and the Aegean sea, warm late-afternoon daylight. Composition rules: place the main subject ONLY in the right third of the frame. Keep the left two-thirds calm and uncluttered (open sky, soft sea or plain surfaces) because a white headline and a search box will sit there. Keep every important detail out of the top 15% and the bottom 15% of the image - they get cropped on wide screens. No text, no letters, no logos, no signs, no watermarks, no people. Greek setting, but NO famous landmark: not Santorini or Oia, no windmills, no Acropolis, nothing that looks like Croatia, Italy or Spain. Photorealistic, natural colours, not over-saturated, eye-level camera, 35mm lens, sharp and highly detailed. Output: the widest landscape format you support (ideally 2:1, at least 2400 px wide).
prompts.pros: Photorealistic wide landscape photograph for the hero banner of a directory of architects, engineers, builders and craftsmen in Greece. It should feel like 'we design and build' - NOT a boardroom, no laptops dominating the scene. Keep the drawings in the middle band of the frame, not near the bottom edge. prompts.dusk: Edit this exact same image. Keep the identical composition, camera position, framing, crop and every object exactly where it is - do not add, remove or move anything. Change ONLY the time of day to blue hour, about 20 minutes after sunset: deep blue sky with a soft warm glow on the horizon, warm interior lights and street lights switched on. It must NOT be black night - the sky stays clearly blue and the whole scene stays readable. No text, no people. Same output size as the original.
